sections.title: The letter zeta
paragraphs: The letter is called (zeta) /ˈθeta/. Its main sound appears in (zapato) /θaˈpa.to/, which means shoe. The letter makes only one sound in standard European Spanish.

sections.title: Pronouncing the letter
paragraphs: Put the tip of your tongue against the edge of your upper teeth. Blow air through the narrow gap. The sound is voiceless, meaning your voice is off. Touch your throat to check that it does not shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound in (zapato) /θaˈpa.to/ in standard European Spanish. You hear it at the start of a word, in the middle, and at the end of a word like (luz) /luθ/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not buzz this sound like the first sound in English zoo. Keep your voice completely off. Make the quiet hiss heard at the start of English think.
